slug: 2026-07-06 Safaricom Ethiopia partners National ID Program to expand digital identity registration

systems.owner: National ID Program; registration under a joint venture with Safaricom Ethiopia and Africom Technologies PLC for Lots 3 and 4
systems.tiers: registration to be expanded in Afar, Amhara, Tigray, Sidama, South West Ethiopia, Central Ethiopia and South Ethiopia

note: Identity enrolment only; nothing on civil registration.
